bullets.text: The public in Pallikaranai expressed fear over flooding due to a retaining wall being built around the marshland, and the office should investigate who is behind this project.

Larsen and Toubro's cloud and data center unit, Vyoma.AI, broke ground on a new fifty-two megawatt data center facility in Tamil Nadu.
The Tamil Nadu government approved six hundred eighty road improvement and civic projects including the beautification of the Gateway of Chennai at a cost of one hundred thirty-one crore rupees.
The state government sanctioned twenty-two hundred infrastructure projects focusing on roads and water supply across town panchayats, municipalities, and corporations.
